title: 第1391章 木青拜访试探与谋划第1390章 天柱山强者开启传送大阵
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
第1391章木青拜访，试探与谋划
站在虚空之上，木彦很是不解，对着木青问道：“堂姐，这天柱山的目的不简单，他们竟然想要重启传送大阵。”
木青能够猜到一二：“圣墓之中有天柱山圣人想要的宝物，还有可能是他们带了了不得的东西进入天虚之中，现在那些修士被困在天虚之中。
他们自然要想办法开启天虚传送阵，进入里面。”
“不过这传送大阵是上古就建立的，想要开启没有令牌是不可能的事情。”
木彦问到：“难道圣人出手也不行吗？”
木青回道：“圣人是有这个能力，可是天虚之中有秩序法则，会让圣人受伤，陷入危机，在没有必要的情况之下他们是不会冒险的。”
“他们可比任何人都要珍惜自己的寿命。”
“不得不佩服紫天一，合道圣人已经能够推演天机，他竟然能够做到瞒天过海，让合道圣人都推算不到关闭传送大阵。”
“就是不知道圣墓机缘会不会落在他身上。”
木彦惊骇，紫天一这样的算计着实超乎了常人的想象。
木彦问出一个惊人的问题：“堂姐，紫天一能够合道成功吗？”
木青想了一下，最后说到：“不知道，合道并没有想象中的那么简单，天时地利人和，资源充沛，气运隆昌，才有合道的可能。”
“如果天柱山的人开启不了天虚，除非紫天一合道，不然这传送大阵可能永久关闭，可惜了整个天虚秘境和天虚仙城。”
“到时候各种天材地宝都将无法获得，天虚仙城也会真正沦为散修的一座废墟之城。”
短短数月，一座原本在紫云星立足的仙城，就变成了如今模样。
“你先回神龙商会坐镇，这里还有一个人在谋算，我不相信他没有任何想法。”
木彦拱拱手，转身离去。
木青则是朝着前面飞去，很快落在了陆家门前。
一个炼虚修士拦住木青，对着木青问道：“道友是来加入陆家的？”

木青开口道：“我是拜访朋友，我来自神龙商会，和陆道友是好友，还请通传一声。”
说着木青放出半步合道的气息，这让炼虚修士脸色惊恐，将要说的话吞了回去。
急忙躬身道：“前辈稍等，我立刻去通报！”
炼虚修士正想去通报，一道身影出现，对着侍卫说道：“不用了！”
月无瑕出现在大门口，炼虚修士明白，这事情不用他管了，立刻回到原本的位置上。
月无瑕向木青拜见：“拜见前辈，我家家主有请！”
木青打量着月无瑕，眼神一闪，就看到月无双身上已经凝聚成金色蛟龙的气运，瞬间动了心思。
“道友可有兴趣加入神龙商会，神龙商会乃是紫云星前三的大商会，还有圣人坐镇，一定给道友一个满意的酬金。”
木青动了心思，合道气运至关重要，如果有这样一尊气运之女，能够凭空多出合道的机缘。
月无瑕没有想到木青竟然想要挖走她。
她回过神来，委婉地拒绝：“前辈高看了，小女子对现在的生活很是满意，不会考虑其他想法的。”
点到为止，木青也不再说什么，气运这东西太过于缥缈，月无瑕未必能够带来合道的机会。

content_en:
Chapter 1391 Mu Qing’s visit, testing and planning
Standing in the void, Mu Yan was very confused and asked Mu Qing: "Cousin, the purpose of Tianzhu Mountain is not simple. They actually want to restart the teleportation formation."
Mu Qing could guess a thing or two: "There are treasures in the holy tomb that the saints of Tianzhu Mountain want. It is also possible that they brought something incredible into Tianxu, and now those monks are trapped in Tianxu.
Naturally, they had to find a way to open the Tianxu teleportation array and enter it. "
"However, this teleportation formation was established in ancient times. It is impossible to open it without a token."
Muyan asked: "Isn't it okay for the saint to take action?"
Mu Qing replied: "Saints have this ability, but there are laws of order in Tianxu, which will cause saints to be injured and put into crisis. They will not take risks unless necessary."
"They cherish their lifespan more than anyone else."
"I have to admire Zi Tianyi. Hedao Saint has been able to deduce the secrets of heaven. He was able to hide the secrets from the sky, so that even Hedao Saint could not figure out the closing of the teleportation formation."
"I just don't know if the opportunity of the Holy Sepulcher will fall on him."
Mu Yan was horrified, Zi Tianyi's calculation was beyond ordinary people's imagination.
Mu Yan asked a surprising question: "Cousin, can Zi Tianyi succeed in joining the Tao?"
Mu Qing thought for a moment and finally said: "I don't know. Harmony is not as simple as imagined. Only when the right time, place, people, abundant resources, and good luck can it be possible."
"If the people in Tianzhu Mountain cannot open Tianxu, unless Zitian unites, the teleportation formation may be permanently closed, which would be a pity for the entire Tianxu Secret Realm and Tianxu Fairy City."
"At that time, all kinds of heavenly materials and earthly treasures will be unavailable, and Tianxu Immortal City will truly become a ruined city for casual cultivators."
In just a few months, a fairy city that was originally based on Ziyun Star became what it is today.
"You go back to the Shenlong Chamber of Commerce and take charge. There is another person here who is planning something. I don't believe he doesn't have any ideas."
Mu Yan cupped his hands and turned to leave.
Mu Qing flew forward and soon landed in front of the Lu family's door.
A Void Refining cultivator stopped Mu Qing and asked, "Fellow Taoist, are you here to join the Lu family?"
Mu Qing said: "I am visiting a friend. I am from the Shenlong Chamber of Commerce and I am a good friend of Lu Daoyou. Please let me know."
As he spoke, Mu Qing let out a breath of half-step Hedao, which made the Xu Lianxu cultivator look horrified and swallowed what he was about to say.
He hurriedly bowed and said: "Senior, wait a moment, I will report immediately!"
When the Xu Lianxu cultivator was about to report, a figure appeared and said to the guard: "No need!"
Yue Wuxia appeared at the gate, and the monk Lianxu understood that he didn't need to worry about this matter, and immediately returned to his original position.
Yue Wuxia paid her respects to Mu Qing: "Senior, the head of my family has invited me!"
Mu Qing looked at Yue Wuxia, and with a flash of his eyes, he saw that Yue Wushuang's luck had condensed into a golden dragon, and he was instantly moved.
"Fellow Taoist, are you interested in joining the Shenlong Chamber of Commerce? The Shenlong Chamber of Commerce is one of the top three chambers of commerce in Ziyun Star. There are also saints in charge. I will definitely give you a satisfactory remuneration."
Mu Qing thought about it. Luck in Hedao was very important. If there was such a woman of luck, she could create more opportunities for Hedao out of thin air.
Yue Wuxia didn't expect Mu Qing to want to poach her.
She came to her senses and declined politely: "Senior, I think the little girl is very satisfied with her current life and will not consider other ideas."
After clicking, Mu Qing stopped saying anything. Luck was too elusive, and Yue Wuxia might not be able to bring about the chance of harmony.
